contract.provides: The source describes 73 rules, a two-state controller, and 24 heterogeneous two-state components without constructing 2^25 = 33,554,432 configurations. For its reported one-opening executed class, 256 product components approximate a correlated post-event entrance law in total variation below 3.774e-9; using the retained correlation changes a later event probability from the prediction using true product marginals. The exact filter for changing interfaces and a controlled uncertain-event-time approximation are reported at theorem level for finite local CTMCs. Rare conditioning requires a denominator lower bound.
contract.requires: one-opening executed class plus finite-local-CTMC theorem
